'''Víctor Rodríguez Soria''' (born 7 September 1987) is an Andorran retired international [[Association football|footballer]] who played as a [[Defender (association football)|defender]]. Rodríguez made his international debut in 2008.

==Career==
On 6 September 2015, in a 3–0 away loss to [[Bosnia and Herzegovina national football team|Bosnia and Herzegovina]] in [[UEFA Euro 2016 qualifying]], [[Muhamed Bešić]] threw his [[chewing gum]] at Rodríguez, who retaliated; both were given straight red cards.<ref>{{cite news|last1=Nightingale|first1=Tom|title=Result: Bosnia-Herzegovina cruise past Andorra|url=https://www.sportsmole.co.uk/football/bosnia-and-herzegovina/euro-2016/result/result-bosnia-herzegovina-cruise-past-andorra_244529.html|accessdate=6 September 2015|publisher=Sports Mole|date=6 September 2015}}</ref>
